call_guidance.additional_balas: Dig用实际上升/天顶角点，不用整宫起点；自然力为固定系数。Drik按Raman113-120方向差、附加特殊值、正负四分之一，未经裁定的水星性质保留scenarios，summary=null不当零；特殊附加值可超过60，不擅自截断。读source_id、nature_context、source_disagreements及shadbala_assessment；Kala/Cheshta须各自核对条件与模型状态，不拼完整六力总量。
call_guidance.birth_grid: 给定生时误差时读取完整30秒以内UTC网格stage_variants及其同生时natal_ruler_contexts；按sample_segments网格序号关联，不能拼名义盘或不同样本。requested/evaluated/omitted针对全网格，旧samples仅端点中心子集并有endpoint_subset计数。相邻变化夹区非精确边界，计数非概率；顶层natal_ruler_context仅名义盘。
call_guidance.cheshta_model: 明确要求五星运动力或深度力量时，可选择simon1994_j2000：Simon1994完整平均黄经、独立几何J2000真位置、原有角度公式。模型仅在1900-2050出生TT窗口承认；analysis_year不改变本命窗口。默认unadjudicated及窗口外保留五星缺失。不是原书1900表校勘、完整六力或预测验证。
call_guidance.clock: 公历。analysis_year给定时缺月/日各取1；完全未给日期按as_of的出生时区日期，未给钟时取00:00。出生与分析时刻的DST歧义需明确UTC偏移。
call_guidance.ephemeris_provenance: ephemeris_model_scope=physical_bodies只汇总七个物理天体及其实际赤道/所选运动帧；Rahu/Ketu见nonphysical_factor_models，平交点为swisseph_analytical_mean_node。native_node_return_flags回显的请求位不证明交点读取了物理矢量文件。physical_backend_policy=strict_jpl表示运行者强制JPL；黄经、赤道、运动力几何与支撑太阳事件均遵守，原生与运动帧共用配置锁。缺失、损坏或越界为来源错误，不默退Moshier；这些来源声明不认证原典或预测效果。
call_guidance.full_export: 完整JSON或时间线导出首次fields=null，保留默认预算，从同run result_delivery取回。
call_guidance.historical_clock: v12支持已明确的birth_clock_basis=civil/local_mean_solar/local_apparent_solar；日期为公历，不猜原始钟制。LMT/LAT省略birth_timezone且use_true_solar_time=false，按已确认地点取经度；birth_second/microsecond仅保留已知或转换数值精度，不证明原记录准确。读india.profile.clock_context及person_info.clock_conversion，区分原始无时区钟面与转换UTC载体。
call_guidance.lunar_nature: Raman53第八日窗口与117-118盈亏表述并不相同。nature_context.moon_readings保留差异；边界及有分歧角距保留两种传统分类，不把旧版单一盈亏标签当作者唯一结论。
call_guidance.periods: Moon-nakshatra，主运/次运从完整原始主运起算；UTC日历标签按每天86400名义秒的datetime口径，不表示连续原子时历时。三种年长口径明确区分，读取elapsed_time_convention。
call_guidance.physical_clock: 出生资料为民用钟时，use_true_solar_time默认false。v11起true只另报太阳钟标签，不改变记录钟时所指的物理时刻、盘面、达沙或模型出生年代窗口。读india.profile.clock_context；solar_wall_datetime无时区，不当另一出生时间，不当分析日期。不能把已知LAT/LMT记录直接当民用资料后开此开关。
call_guidance.reading_fidelity: reading_basis保留名义生时、未评估与抽样候选；不把未给误差当精确。星宿/宿足候选与分盘候选同一UTC网格，计数不是概率。主题力量calculation_context直接携带同run分支数值、约束与字段路径；computed_consensus/conditional_results/unavailable/partially_computed分开，null不一概为0或用户资料不足。不能只选高分支、自动全盘否定或宣称已完成独立文本盲审。Vimshottari敏感性对目标早于候选出生的样本显式列omitted_samples。
call_guidance.scope: 120年是规则周期，不是寿命估计；读当前ruler的本命上下文，不能将边界写成事件必发生。
call_guidance.solar_component_scope: Kala太阳依赖分开：日主/时主读连续日出对，三分力读当前相邻昼夜端点；partial_solar_brackets只限制对应分量。读取solar_context及同run constraints，不因缺其他日落抹去已有结果，也不补假日出。网格状态计数不是概率。
call_guidance.solar_event_scope: 日出／日落支撑窗口逐项检索同一UT1日界内的连续事件；不假定每天仅一个同类事件。solar_events.enumeration的1秒仅是检索防重复步长，不是出生记录或实测精度。
call_guidance.solar_uncertainty: 仅传用户确认的误差；太阳钟输入先换算原钟面区间两端，再取最长30秒物理UTC网格。保留clock_interval原始标签、转换端点、非对称offset及全部候选；覆盖计数非概率，不当连续区间证明。require_data_files同样检查LAT求解和端点换算的每次太阳坐标，不用最后一次成功掩盖中途降级。
call_guidance.sthana_sources: Saptavargaja与Drekkana独立选源；默认Drekkana为santhanam_27_6。Raman36详细条文与例12取15，摘要105取60冲突仍保留在source_reading_conflicts；比较读法不挑最高值，也不认证完整单一原典六力。
call_guidance.strength: 主次运星可结合india.strengths.sthana_bala及其profile阅读位置分量；不把位置强度直接写成事件概率。
call_guidance.target_timezone: analysis_timezone独立指定目标民用时区；不改变出生换算。省略时民用出生沿用其解析时区，LMT/LAT出生明确默认UTC。用户目标地时区可由已确认城市整理，不把原太阳钟当目标民用时区；读analysis_context.timezone_basis，DST歧义用明确UTC偏移。
call_guidance.temporal_balas: Kala与Cheshta均为出生时刻的本命分量，不是analysis_year/as_of的时运。Natha按视太阳过中天，Hora按日出后等长平均小时，不套西占不等时小时；日主日出换日，岁/月主为360/30日传统口径。月亮第八日窗口与盈亏读法、水星性质保留scenarios；星战金额按Raman76-77固定系数及本次前置力量条件计算，读取yuddha_bala.evidence/upstream_profile。同经、黄经零点、多星交战、缺少前置量仍为partial，保留同一分支关联，不把规则胜负当现实胜负。太阳/月亮运动力按所选Ayana/Paksha，五星默认未选择平均模型而保留null；可显式选择cheshta_model=simon1994_j2000，在1900-2050出生TT窗口计算现代长期平均模型，读取model_context，不冒充Raman1900表；不填零、不拼完整六力总分。

ashtakavarga.when: 未削减八分法：按具名Rao2000规则读取PAV/BAV/SAV、贡献者及本次分盘方法；计数不是概率，生时抽样变体另读敏感性。

ashtakavarga_reductions.when: 按具名Rao2000七曜占据口径读取reduction_analysis：原始BAV不改，未决相等分支为空值，保留每步来源与七曜加权。Pinda未接入事件择时或概率。

ashtakavarga_source_profiles.when: 印度盘按来源比较原始BAV与削减：Rao默认保留，Aiyar1905使用自己的七曜672单元及自身削减；旧的仅换削减读法与完整原始表口径分开，不拼其他作者的Pinda或事件概率。

dasha_levels.when: 要求PD/SD/PAD/DAD时先显式设置dasha_depth=3..6；读取当前完整运主链、逐层九个子期及同生时网格候选，timeline仍只有MD/AD。细分不代表事件精度或概率。

santhanam_drishti_witnesses.when: 核对 Santhanam 26/27.19 的译文、注解和 540 行普通相位表来源（含两处坐标标注冲突）；该来源未应用于当前 Raman Drik 计算。

stage.when: 指定目标时刻主运与次运；不代表全年逐月扫描。

timeline.when: 目标所在完整120年规则周期、出生剩余运和全部次运。

analysis_day.description: Target Gregorian day, validated against the resolved year/month. Defaults to 1 when year or month is supplied; otherwise the as_of/current local day.

analysis_hour.description: Target civil-clock hour (0..23) in analysis_timezone or its declared default; defaults to00:00. Ambiguous DST target times require an explicit UTC offset for the target zone; the birth clock conversion remains independent.

analysis_minute.description: Target local civil-clock minute (0..59), paired with analysis_hour; omitted minutes default to 0. The result reports the resolved analysis_datetime and UTC period boundaries.

analysis_month.description: Target Gregorian month (1..12). Defaults to January with an explicit analysis_year, otherwise the as_of/current local month. Supplying a month defaults an omitted day to 1.

analysis_timezone.description: Civil target clock timezone, independent of the birth clock basis. Defaults to resolved birth civil timezone for civil input, or UTC for LMT/LAT input. It never changes the birth conversion or defines a solar target clock.

analysis_year.description: Gregorian target year in analysis_timezone, else resolved birth civil zone or UTC for solar birth input. Omit to use that zone's date frozen by as_of/current clock; an explicit year defaults omitted month/day to January1.

as_of.description: Freeze implicit current time: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone

birth_clock_basis.description: Basis explicitly identified in the birth record. LMT/LAT requires birth_timezone omitted and use_true_solar_time=false; east-positive longitude and shared TT/UT1 convert it to an instant. Never infer an unknown clock basis by fitting the chart or outcomes.

birth_latitude.description: Birth latitude. Optional for core chart endpoints when FateBridge can infer it from a supported birth_place.

birth_longitude.description: Birth longitude. Optional for core chart endpoints when FateBridge can infer it from a supported birth_place.

birth_microsecond.description: Numerical fraction of the supplied second, including explicitly converted clocks; does not certify source clock precision.

birth_second.description: Recorded second, if known; omitted uses the beginning of the minute, not a claim of exact recording precision. Leap-second labels are not represented.

birth_time_uncertainty_minutes.description: User-confirmed +/- minutes. Civil input uses elapsed minutes around its resolved instant; LMT/LAT uses a recorded solar-wall interval whose endpoints are converted first. None means unknown, not exact. A physical UTC grid of at most30 seconds includes endpoints and nominal instant.

birth_timezone.description: Civil birth timezone: explicit IANA name or UTC offset, or supported unambiguous birth_place inference. Unresolved civil timezones are rejected before sky calculations; coordinates, analysis_timezone and a solar-display request cannot establish the recorded zone. Explicit UTC is valid. Explicit LMT/LAT input requires this field omitted and a confirmed noncivil birth_clock_basis.

cheshta_model.description: Five-star motional mean model: default keeps missing values; simon1994_j2000 explicitly selects modern secular means and separate geometric J2000 true positions, admitted1900-2050 TT only. Not Raman1900 tables, complete Shadbala or real-world predictive evidence. Sun/Moon rules remain separate.

compact.description: 紧凑 JSON 输出（无缩进）；设为 false 则美化缩进。默认 true。

dasha_depth.description: Vimshottari levels:2=MD/AD(default),3=PD,4=SD,5=PAD,6=DAD. Above2 adds the active ancestry and nine siblings per lower level, using complete-period fractions. The existing120-year timeline remains MD/AD only. Birth-grid variants follow all selected rulers; finer labels are not event precision or probabilities.

divisions.description: Parashari charts to include: D2 traditional Sun/Moon Hora, D3, D7, D9, D10, D12, D30 unequal sign assignments only (no invented D30 longitude). Default [9,10]; D1 always included, [] requests D1 only.

drekkana_profile.description: D1 decanate positional strength, independently of Saptavargaja: Santhanam27.6 gives Moon/Venus the middle decanate, Mercury/Saturn the last; Raman36 reverses them. Both use15 Virupa. Raman's detailed section36 and Example12 are selected explicitly; its conflicting summary60 remains unresolved. Not D3 chart longitude or whole-book acceptance.

ephemeris_policy.description: auto reports actual Swiss/Moshier provenance; require_data_files rejects analytical fallback for physical coordinates, sensitivity/rise-set samples and every Sun call resolving LAT clocks and their interval endpoints. Does not certify empirical prediction accuracy.

fields.description: 仅返回选定字段以节省 token：接受顶层键（如 'snapshot_text'）或点路径子字段（如 'bazi_birth.day_master'）。run_metadata 始终保留；留空请求全部字段，超出响应字符预算的部分由 result_delivery 保留供读取。无效路径默认附 projection_warnings；strict_fields=true 时拒绝。

gender.description: 性别（可选，仅用于结果标识；西方星盘计算不使用性别）。接受此字段是为了让同一套出生信息可以原样喂给八字/紫微/星盘等工具，避免批量调用时'有的工具收、有的不收'造成的反复试错。

hsys.description: Optional offline house system override; if omitted, FateBridge keeps each chart variant's historical default. Explicit values currently support 0=whole_sign, 1=Alcabitus, 2=Regiomontanus, 3=Placidus, 4=Koch, 5=Vehlow Equal, 6=Polich Page, 7=Sripati, 8=equal_mc Explicit values must be integer codes0..8; boolean, floating-point, blank and out-of-range values are rejected.

include_snapshot_text.description: 是否包含人类可读的 snapshot_text 文本段（默认随工具而定）；设为 false 可显著减少返回的 token 数。

node_mode.description: Rahu: mean or true lunar node; Ketu is opposite.

parent_run_id.description: Parent call's run_id; correlation only, no stored execution lookup

response_char_limit.description: 完整 JSON 响应字符预算：0 不限制，或 4096–65536。MCP 默认 8192，REST/CLI 默认 0。超限不截断数据，返回 result_delivery 完整结果引用和可读取字段；按 manifest_uri 或字段分页读取原 run 的数据，不要重新计算或解析单页为完整文档。

saptavargaja_profile.description: Saptavargaja coefficients and moolatrikona scope: Santhanam27 literal seven-sign reading or Raman30 D1-only exception. Changes this component only; Drekkana is independently selected by drekkana_profile. Neither certifies full Shadbala or predictive validity.

strict_fields.description: 是否拒绝无效 fields 路径；默认 false，使用宽松投影并返回警告。

use_true_solar_time.description: Report an apparent-solar wall-clock label separately. Recorded civil birth time and its physical ephemeris instant are preserved with either setting; this option cannot select a different birth date, dasha start or mean-model window. A known historical LAT/LMT record is not a civil input and must not be guessed with this switch.

year_basis.description: Fixed elapsed-day year convention, applied to all major/subperiod boundaries. No universal convention is implied.

zodiacal.description: Optional offline zodiac override; if omitted, FateBridge keeps each chart variant's historical default. Explicit values currently support 0=tropical and 1=sidereal(Lahiri-like)
